We’re looking for a talented and passionate Game Designer & Game Lead to join Wildlife’s New Games team . Wildlife is constantly building and releasing new titles with the goal of bringing fun to billions of people around the world. The company has already surpassed the mark of 4 billion downloads. The New Games Product team is accountable for defining which new games will be produced and building these products in partnership with engineers and artists. These are the products that will drive the company’s growth for the following years.

As a Wildlife Game Designer & Game Lead , you will define new game theses to be validated by the executives team, you will also be accountable for the game’s vision throughout the development cycle, from prototyping to global launch. You will use player feedback, data analysis and accurate business sense to improve the game’s performance.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company’s success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, and comfortable in a “take the initiative” environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you’ll do

  • Using market research, propose new game theses that can be played by millions of people for multiple years
  • Define the new game’s vision and product roadmap (adapting it if needed as we gather more data about the product)
  • Design the game’s main features and write their specifications
  • In partnership with the game’s art leader and the distribution team define the game theme and art style
  • Review game design decisions made by the rest of the team (artists and engineers)
  • Coordinate deliveries within the core team and with related disciplines (engineering, art, distribution, data science)
  • Provide product and game design leadership through your own experience, competitor analyses, playtests, player feedback, data analysis, etc.) within the product’s core team
  • Analyze the performance of new versions and features released. Continuously refine the roadmap based on new findings

What you’ll need

  • Experience in product or game design roles within game development (shipping games on any platform, leading product development in game jams or hackathons)
  • Passionate about games, you have been a player your whole life
  • Flexibility to work in iterative development cycles with frequent releases
  • Strong interpersonal skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience shipping mobile games
  • Programming skills that allow you to develop prototypes independently
  • Experience using AI tools for art creation or programming

More about you

  • Excited about joining the most valuable, highest growth start-up in Brazil that will provide you meaningful work, meaningful relationships, continuous meaningful learning, and a team radically committed to produce great products
  • Thoughtful and analytical decision-maker: you consider multiple solutions to the same problem and can see nuance where others don’t to decide what level of detail/sophistication you’ll need to make an informed timely decision
  • A structured and creative thinker: with a structured mindset you are able to harness chaos into a logical architecture, where others would give-up you won’t, and by digging into benchmarks you’re able to uncover unthinkable solutions to your day‑by‑day problems
  • A natural but humble leader and mentor: as an accomplished leader, you’re able to speak on a broad spectrum of topics; your demeanor diffuses conflicts and puts people at ease, helping you give constructive feedback and build relationships across cultures and interacting and coordinating the work of several teams, to extract the most value from each team member
  • A multicultural gamer: you love gaming (console, mobile, board, or card games) as much as we do, so you’ll plug that passion into providing players’ needs with unparalleled focus

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Finland, and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

  • You are an expert in statistical analysis and machine learning with deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications.

  • You possess knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain)
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $21/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

description:
Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior (Node.js)

A Flash é uma Startup RHTech Brasileira, unimos tecnologia, pessoas e inovação para transformar a maneira como as empresas (e seus RHs) atuam e cuidam de seus integrantes. Desde 2018, atuamos com:

  • Gestão de benefícios (temos um cartão multibenefícios aceito em milhões de lugares no Brasil e no mundo)
  • Pessoas (nossos serviços incluem gestão de pessoas e controle de pontos de maneira descomplicada) e
  • Despesas (com a Flash, reembolsos, envio de notas fiscais e o controle das despesas corporativas são simplificados)

E nós unificamos essa experiência em uma só plataforma — acima de tudo, geramos impacto real na vida de milhares de pessoas.

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Software Sênior para integrar nosso time responsável pela Plataforma de comunicação da Flash, um sistema inovador que abstrai múltiplos canais de comunicação (WhatsApp, SMS, e-mail) e proporciona funcionalidades avançadas com integração a modelos de linguagem (LLMs) para automação e inteligência. Se você é apaixonado por construir soluções de comunicação escaláveis, otimizar processos através de integração com eventos em tempo real (Kafka), e deseja atuar em uma arquitetura moderna que utiliza microserviços, essa vaga é para você!

Por que trabalhar com a gente?

  • Acreditamos que grandes transformações acontecem por meio de pessoas inconformadas, e os nossos valores são guias para nossas tomadas de decisões e crescimento alavancado:
  • Criamos valor com o Cliente
  • Resolvemos problemas com Pragmatismo
  • Jogamos Juntos
  • Entregamos Resultados Consistentes
  • Aprendemos e Transformamos

Nosso jeitinho de trabalhar:

  • Na Flash, você fará parte de um negócio em constante crescimento e transformação, com autonomia para criar, testar e transformar ideias em soluções reais que impactam empresas e pessoas em todo o Brasil.
  • Valorizamos quem busca mais do que a média: aqui, você cresce junto com o negócio, aumenta seu valor no mercado e é reconhecido por sua alta performance.
  • Trabalhamos com leveza, autenticidade e colaboração, em um ambiente informal, fluido e sem burocracias, onde grandes transformações nascem da liberdade de ser quem se é.
  • Nosso ritmo é intenso, nosso aprendizado é contínuo e cada desafio é uma nova chance de evoluir, experimentar e fazer diferente — com propósito e paixão

Sobre o time:

  • Nosso time de tecnologia é formado por profissionais que não apenas desenvolvem soluções tecnológicas de ponta, mas também estão sempre em busca de inovação e melhorias constantes
  • Aqui, você vai ter a oportunidade de impactar diretamente a vida dos nossos usuários com soluções rápidas, eficientes e escaláveis. Trabalhamos com uma stack moderna, utilizando Node.js, React, TypeScript, MongoDB e AWS

Nossos benefícios:

  • Cartão Flash com benefícios flexíveis: refeição, alimentação, mobilidade, saúde, educação, cultura e bem-estar
  • Plano de saúde
  • Seguro de vida
  • Licença-maternidade e paternidade estendidas + Auxílio creche
  • Day off no seu aniversário
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido e flexível + Auxílio home office + Experiências no escritório
  • Descontos exclusivos com parceiros no app da Flash

Principais Desafios:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar a arquitetura de integração de canais de comunicação, incluindo WhatsApp, SMS e E-mail, garantindo uma experiência omnichannel fluida e unificada
  • Trabalhar com Kafka como backbone de eventos, orquestrando a comunicação entre os serviços da plataforma (ex: Agent Broker, Conversational Service, LLM Integration)
  • Integrar LLMs (Large Language Models) para automação de respostas inteligentes e processamento de mensagens com base no histórico de conversas e contexto do usuário
  • Construir e manter sistemas robustos e escaláveis, como os serviços de persistência de conversas, roteamento de mensagens, e controle de políticas (rate limiting, retry exponencial, DLQ)
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de dados entre os serviços (ex: eventos e comandos Kafka) para garantir a eficiência e a entrega rápida de mensagens através de múltiplos canais
  • Garantir a observabilidade do sistema, utilizando ferramentas como Grafana para monitoramento de latência, taxa de entrega e desempenho geral da plataforma
  • Trabalhar na evolução contínua da plataforma, incluindo funcionalidades como transbordo entre canais e políticas avançadas de confiança em IA

O que Buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida em Back-End, especialmente com TypeScript e Node.js
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de mensageria e processamento de eventos em tempo real, especialmente Kafka
  • Integração com APIs de comunicação, como Webhooks de WhatsApp (Meta), provedores de SMS e servidores SMTP/ESP para envio de e-mails
  • Experiência com microserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas, com foco em escalabilidade e performance
  • Experiência com observabilidade: utilizar ferramentas como Grafana para monitorar e otimizar o desempenho do sistema

O que Esperamos:

  • Visão estratégica para desenvolvimento de sistemas que abranjam múltiplos canais de comunicação e integração com IA
  • Trabalho colaborativo em times multidisciplinares, com capacidade de articular soluções técnicas e simplificar problemas complexos
  • Proatividade para lidar com desafios técnicos e otimizar processos com soluções inovadoras

Qualificações Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Whatsapp para automação de respostas e personalização de mensagens
  • Conhecimento em AWS Cloud ou outras plataformas de cloud para otimização e escalabilidade de infraestrutura
  • Experiência com workflows e engines de automação, como o futuro Workflow Engine (HITL), que permite interações humanas em tarefas automatizadas

  • Conhecimento prático do framework Kedro, com experiência em sua aplicação para estruturar e gerenciar projetos de ciência de dados de forma eficiente;

description:
Sobre a Dynamox

Somos uma indústria especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a manutenção preditiva de ativos industriais. O objetivo da nossa solução é transformar a indústria, tornando-a mais segura e mais produtiva do que ontem.

Ao produzirmos os hardwares e softwares da nossa solução, buscamos apresentar aos nossos clientes e parceiros o porquê somos referência em soluções eficientes e eficazes para monitoramento, manutenção e performance de ativos. Reconhecemos e valorizamos a diversidade de habilidades e experiências que cada pessoa possui. Nosso compromisso é garantir oportunidades igualitárias para todos os talentos, respeitando a singularidade de cada indivíduo e promovendo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor.

Além disso, temos orgulho de possuir as certificações das ISO 9001, 27001, 27018, 27701. Por meio delas, promovemos a organização e a estrutura de nossos processos, resultando em um ambiente de trabalho mais organizado e eficiente.

Sobre a equipe na qual você irá atuar:

A equipe de Product Design zela pela melhor experiência dos usuários nos pontos de contato com os produtos da Dynamox. Somos uma equipe facilitadora e criativa — formada por Product Designers, Visual Designers e 3D Artists — responsável por pesquisar, analisar, projetar experiências e apresentações dos produtos da Dynamox. Acreditamos que a colaboração é um artefato extremamente importante no nosso dia a dia e, por isso, atuamos em conjunto com Product Managers, Analistas de Dados, Desenvolvedores, Engenheiros, Analistas de Suporte e profissionais do Marketing.

Atividades do cargo

  • Elaborar fluxos de usuários, wireframes, protótipos e componentes visando aprimorar a experiência do cliente;
  • Realizar pesquisas quantitativas e/ou qualitativas para identificar oportunidades e problemas na experiência de uso dos produtos;
  • Facilitar e liderar dinâmicas de geração de ideias, alinhamento e consenso com o time e demais envolvidos na iniciativa;
  • Acompanhar e analisar métricas de experiência de uso dos produtos;
  • Garantir a qualidade nos projetos desenvolvidos, mantendo a consistência com os atributos da marca e a experiência em todo o ecossistema de produto;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento e colaborar no desenvolvimento do time e dos colegas;
  • Contribuir e disseminar práticas de segurança da informação, zelando pela confidencialidade, integridade, disponibilidade e privacidade das informações e dados.

Requisitos

  • Capacidade de realizar pesquisas, analisar os dados e gerar inputs que visam a transformação do negócio e a experiência do usuário;
  • Capacidade de utilizar conceitos de tipografia, grid, cores, consistência/coerência visual, iconografia, espaçamentos, alinhamentos, hierarquia visual para desenvolver um produto coeso e excepcional;
  • Estruturar a interface dos produtos de forma consistente e que facilite o sucesso do usuário dentro de uma jornada;
  • Capacidade de utilizar ferramentas para prototipação, manipulação de imagens, analytics e pesquisa;
  • Experiência de 3-5 anos na área de design e UX;
  • Experiência pessoal ou profissional com a língua inglesa.

Formação

  • Ensino superior concluído em Design Gráfico, Design de Produto, Marketing, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-Graduação/Especialização em andamento em Design de Produto, UX ou áreas correlatas;
  • Cursos livres da área de design e experiência do usuário;

Benefícios

  • Transporte: vale transporte ou auxílio deslocamento sem desconto em folha;
  • Cartão multi-benefícios: um cartão flexível, facilitando o uso do vale alimentação/refeição flexível, onde você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Overview

Join to apply for the HR Generalist role at Brex .

Brex is the AI-powered spend platform. We help companies spend with confidence with integrated corporate cards, banking, and global payments, plus intuitive software for travel and expenses. Tens of thousands of companies from startups to enterprises use Brex to proactively control spend, reduce costs, and increase efficiency on a global scale.

What You’ll Do

As an HR Generalist, you will be focused on taking care of our most important investment at Brex: our employees. In this hybrid role, you’ll support Brazil-based employees and complete key People Operations processes that span Brex’s global workforce. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are approachable and solution-focused. You possess a deep understanding of Brazilian labor laws and have a good grasp on Brazilian market practices and how they impact HR programs and policies. You have a passion for, and are excited about, building great companies, including implementing and managing processes and programs that help Brex employees do their best work every day.

Responsibilities

  • Global People Operations
    • Provide operational support to a dedicated global department and provide expert guidance on HR-related inquiries, troubleshooting and resolving issues, and supporting employees through various milestones within the employee life cycle
    • Guide and assist employees and our partner teams through key People Operation processes such as hiring, promotions, internal transfers, leaves of absences, and separations - while managing and completing these actions in Workday and Jira.
  • Brazil People Operations
    • Act as the primary point of contact for Brazil-based employees, providing timely and accurate support on HR policies, processes, and programs.
    • Utilize knowledge of Brazil labor laws and market employment best practices to interpret Brazil labor laws and regulations into actionable guidelines for Brex; collaborate with employment counsel to ensure programs and policies are compliant.
    • Drive key Brazil People Operations processes such as annual union contributions, and support broader Brazil people programs including dissídio adjustments.
    • Proactively partner with internal teams (benefits, compensation, payroll, recruiting, workplace) to optimize and build Brazil processes and programs, ensuring exceptional employee experience while aligning with business needs.
    • Build strong relationships with external Brazilian vendors and serve as main contact to ensure benefits and payroll run smoothly. Act as liaison between brokers, internal teams, and employees to resolve issues as needed.
    • Responsible for monitoring union updates to effectively communicate and implement any CBA-related obligations.
    • Ensure compliance with applicable labor regulations by tracking, preparing, and maintaining all required reports and documentation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required
  • 4+ years of HR experience in Brazil, working with HRIS, benefits, payroll, LOAs
  • Significant understanding of Brazil labor laws
  • Proven knowledge and passion for implementing HR policies and programs from the ground up, and enhancing existing processes to drive operational efficiency and employee satisfaction
  • Strong communication skills in English, including reading, writing, and speaking
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintaining attention to detail and accuracy
  • Discretion, integrity, and judgment in handling confidential information
  • Strong familiarity with HRIS systems and tools
  • Able to build trust and rapport quickly
  • Experience working in high-growth global technology companies
  • Power user of Google Suite

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Workday and Jira
  • Experience supporting a global workforce, including employees based in the United States & Canada
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (e.g., IF/THEN, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, formulas)

title: Account Manager - São Paulo
description:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for renewals and stakeholder management.

You will work in coordination with Customer Success Managers, and you will be the primary contact of the executives. Your primary responsibility will be to drive renewal, create expansion and MRR Raise opportunities, contract terms including price negotiations, and manage high-level stakeholders through all account bases. Your daily responsibilities will include sponsor nurturing, discovering all stakeholders and their needs to be matched with Insider One product suites, Business Reviews, renewal processes, contract negotiations.

What You Will Do

  • Participating in meetings with key stakeholders, starting with onboarding kick-off and Business Review meetings
  • Discovering strategic needs and directions of the customers, setting goals and objectives with the customer that will enable the teams to drive business impact
  • Analyzing stakeholder mapping and setting overall strategy to capture the right frequency in touchpoints
  • Taking ownership of renewal success and strategy to achieve key commercial and contractual targets
  • Assisting sales with upselling and initiating opportunities with the right product and the right contact
  • Owning commercial targets regarding gross margin, collection package raises, and service level adjustments in the existing customer portfolio
  • Ensuring Customer Success realization is achieved and recognized across key stakeholders and reaching NPS targets, ensuring the best customer experience and success recognition
  • Achieving customer advocacy goals with the marketing team through success stories, testimonials, and so on
  • Monitoring market trends and industry analysis to nurture key stakeholders aligned with Insider One Product and Strategic Roadmap execution
  • While this isn't a team management role, you will still have the opportunity to share your expertise with the rest of the team and even lead them in internal projects.

What You Will Need

  • A university degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or related fields
  • 5+ years experience in Customer Success Management, Account Management, or Sales, ideally in SaaS
  • Strong communication skills in both writing and speaking (English & Native Language)
  • High sense of responsibility and accountability
  • Strategic thinking with excellent project management skills
  • Competency in sales methodologies such as Value Selling, Challenger Selling or Spin Selling is a plus
  • Proven track record of using sales & persuasive skills
  • Experience in negotiating and navigating contracts and legal discussions
  • Adaptability to a fast-paced, high growth, rapidly changing environment
  • Proven track record of driving decisions collaboratively, resolving conflicts, and ensuring follow-through with verbal and written communication.
  • Strong presentation skills with a high degree of comfort with large and small audiences and various levels of management (Senior Executives, IT management, Database administrators, and Data Scientist).
  • Proven track record of building relationships and need discovery with senior customer executives in enterprise or highly strategic accounts.
  • Experience in managing various stakeholder relationships to get consensus on solutions/engagements required.

What We Offer

  • We offer many hard and soft skills training opportunities to help you improve and challenge yourself. You’ll have access to 16,000+ online courses taught by real-world professionals on the LinkedIn Learning platform to satisfy your hunger for knowledge.
  • You’ll have space to share your skills through training and workshops if you wish. Sharing is caring!
  • We’ll provide you with a paid Spotify account subscription, so you can cozy up in your headset cocoon whenever you want.
  • You’ll have a chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment.
  • Our working model embraces the best of both worlds with a delightful hybrid approach, where we head to the office three times a week to foster creativity, collaboration, and a vibrant team spirit.
  • You’ll be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences.
  • Don’t believe us? Just ask Google.

We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.

To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.

We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

Somos a Kaizen - A Casa da Autopeça, uma das bandeiras do Grupo Bueno - um grupo formado por empresas diferentes com um propósito comum.

Atualmente, o Grupo Bueno é composto por quatro bandeiras:

- Kaizen - A Casa da Autopeça: Um atacarejo focado em venda para mecânicos e consumidores finais;

- Portal: Uma solução de e-commerce para mecânicos.

O Grupo Bueno nasceu em 1994 com a Pecista, a maior distribuidora de autopeças do Distrito Federal.

A partir de 2019, iniciamos nossa expansão com a Kaizen - A Casa da Autopeça, criada para aumentar a proximidade com as oficinas e atender a pessoa física.

Atualmente, a Kaizen possui cinco filiais no Distrito Federal: Asa Norte, Ceilândia, Gama, SOF Sul e Planaltina-DF.

E não vamos parar por ai! Brasília foi apenas o começoe em 2024 iniciamos nossa operação fora do DF, agora em Goiânia!

O que é o nosso Banco de Talentos?

É uma forma de você se conectar com a Kaizen e o Grupo Bueno, mesmo que ainda não tenhamos uma vaga aberta no momento que se encaixe no seu perfil. Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará registrado no nosso banco para futuras oportunidades.

title: Outbound & Lifecycle Marketing Specialist
description:
Overview

BlackBox Strategies is seeking a senior, execution-first operator to own outbound and lifecycle messaging across both B2B and B2C audiences .

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Is an expert at hands-on execution
  • Can collaborate on strategy, then independently ship
  • Understands how B2B and B2C motions differ across email, CRM, and SMS
  • Works closely with a Social Media Manager to align messaging and timing

You will partner with leadership on direction and priorities, then own execution end-to-end .

About BlackBox Strategies

BlackBox Strategies is a revenue execution agency that helps businesses grow through disciplined GTM strategy, outbound execution, and lifecycle optimization. We design and operate revenue systems across email, CRM, and digital channels—bridging strategy and hands-on execution to drive measurable results for both B2B and B2C clients.

Location

Remote | Open to global candidates (U.S. business hours required)

Key Responsibilities

Cold Email & Outbound Execution

  • Build and maintain outbound lists and enrichment workflows using Clay
  • Launch, manage, and optimize cold email campaigns in Instantly
  • Own inbox health, deliverability, warm-up, and reply categorization
  • Sync replies, outcomes, and lifecycle stages into HubSpot
  • Continuously test messaging by segment, persona, and intent

Lifecycle & Marketing Email (B2B + B2C)

  • Build segmented audiences across lead, prospect, and customer stages
  • Execute nurture, re-engagement, abandoned inquiry, and expansion campaigns
  • Manage compliance, suppression logic, and list hygiene
  • Use HubSpot Marketing Hub and/or Mailchimp

SMS Marketing (Nice to Have)

  • Support compliant, high-intent SMS use cases (follow-ups, reminders, re-engagement)
  • Experience with platforms such as Twilio or similar is a strong plus
  • Coordinate SMS timing with email and social campaigns

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with the Social Media Manager to align themes, CTAs, and timing
  • Share outbound insights to inform social and content strategy
  • Partner with leadership on ICPs, testing priorities, and iteration

Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in outbound, lifecycle marketing, or RevOps-adjacent roles
  • Direct experience executing (not just overseeing) email and CRM campaigns
  • Experience supporting both B2B and B2C audiences
  • Strong understanding of deliverability, segmentation, and channel tradeoffs
  • Clear written communicator with a bias toward execution

title: Associate Producer
description:
Overview

About High Scale — We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an Associate Producer who is the ultimate organizer, anticipating needs and keeping our high-velocity production engine running smoothly.

Why This Role Matters

Momentum, organization, and details are your playground. As an Associate Producer, you are the right hand of the Production team. You operate in the trenches, ensuring that briefs are clear, assets are organized, timelines are met, and quality is maintained.

You are the glue that holds the creative process together. While the Senior Producers look at the big picture, you ensure no detail slips through the cracks. Your work directly impacts our efficiency and speed to market. If you are a master multi-tasker looking to learn the ropes of high-end commercial production from the inside out, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  • Support End-to-End Production
    • Assist Senior Producers in managing the daily workflow of video campaigns, from project kickoff to final delivery.
    • Track the status of dozens of simultaneous projects, updating project management boards (Asana, ClickUp, Notion) in real-time.
    • Flag potential blockers or delays immediately and work to resolve them before they impact the deadline.
  • Asset Management & Organization
    • Act as the gatekeeper for creative assets. Ensure raw footage, music, scripts, and brand guidelines are organized and accessible to the editing team.
    • Perform quality checks on incoming assets from creators and outgoing deliverables from editors (checking for correct specs, spelling, and audio levels).
  • Coordinate Creative Teams
    • Serve as a liaison between the creative team (editors, designers) and the account team.
    • Translate feedback into clear, actionable notes for editors to execute.
    • Ensure creative briefs are fully populated with all necessary information before production begins.
  • Resource & Vendor Support
    • Assist in sourcing voice-over talent, stock footage, or specialized freelancers as needed.
    • Handle administrative tasks related to production, such as contract management, release forms, and invoicing.

Who You Are

  • A Rising Production Talent
    • 1–3 years of experience in production, project management, or account coordination (agency or digital media preferred).
    • You have a basic understanding of the video production lifecycle (Pre-Pro, Production, Post).
  • The Most Organized Person in the Room
    • You love checklists, spreadsheets, and color-coded calendars.
    • You have an obsession with file naming conventions and folder structures.
  • Proactive Problem Solver
    • You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see a gap in the process or a missing file, and you fix it.
    • You are "solution-first" in your communication style.
  • Tech-Savvy
    • Proficient in project management tools (Asana, Monday, ClickUp) and Google Suite.
    • Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere, Frame.io) is a massive plus, even if you aren’t an editor.
  • Excellent Communicator
    • Strong English proficiency is required. You are clear, concise, and professional in Slack, email, and Zoom. You know how to chase people for deliverables without being annoying.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: This is the training ground for becoming a Senior Producer. Master the details, and the path upward is clear.
  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one perfectly managed project at a time.

Esses números não foram construídos sozinhos, nos bastidores, contamos com um time plural e dedicado em trazer resultados aos nossos clientes. Construímos uma cultura através da experiência de ser um Fiscalovers. Valorizamos a busca contínua por aprendizagem e prezamos por um desenvolvimento centrado na autonomia individual. Vem ser um Fiscalovers!

Responsibilities

  • Auxiliar a equipe na resolução de problemas técnicos e no desenvolvimento de soluções, promovendo as melhores práticas de codificação e garantindo a qualidade do código.
  • Atuar como um ponto de referência para decisões técnicas, como seleção de ferramentas, linguagens e metodologias, sempre alinhando com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Definir e acompanhar prazos, cadência de execução e recursos necessários para a entrega dos projetos.
  • Dividir projetos em tarefas menores, facilitando o acompanhamento e a execução, mantendo a equipe alinhada e produtiva.
  • Identificar e mitigar riscos que possam impactar o cronograma ou a qualidade dos entregáveis.
  • Atuar como mentor dos desenvolvedores, promovendo o desenvolvimento das habilidades técnicas e soft skills.
  • Fornecer feedback regular e construtivo para melhorar a performance individual e coletiva.
  • Participar do processo de recrutamento, seleção e onboarding de novos membros da equipe.
  • Supervisionar o código da equipe, realizando revisões e garantindo que esteja alinhado com os padrões de qualidade e segurança.
  • Implementar e incentivar a prática de testes automatizados e integração contínua, promovendo a confiabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Manter uma comunicação eficaz com outras áreas, como Produto, Design e Gestão, para alinhar expectativas e requisitos.
  • Fornecer atualizações periódicas sobre o progresso dos projetos e apresentar resultados aos gestores e à alta administração.
  • Explorar e recomendar novas tecnologias ou metodologias que possam trazer melhorias ao processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Documentar processos e padrões técnicos, assegurando que as práticas de desenvolvimento possam ser seguidas consistentemente.

Qualifications

  • Ensino superior completo em Redes de Computadores, Sistemas da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou Engenharia da Computação.
  • Inglês avançado para leitura e escrita.
  • Especialização, cursos e/ou certificações em Gestão de Times utilizando metodologias ágeis.
  • Especialização, cursos e/ou certificações em Engenharia de software, arquitetura de software.
  • Especialização, cursos e/ou certificações em Gerenciamento de Projetos.
  • Especialização, cursos e/ou certificações em Segurança da Informação.
  • Especialização, cursos e/ou certificações em LGPD.

  • Experiência mínima de 3+ como desenvolvedor de software Web e Desktop.
  • Experiência em implantação de processos de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) para gerenciamento de projetos e conhecimento em uso de ferramentas como JIRA, ZohoSprint, Trello, etc.
  • Experiência em Startups com produtos SAAS em ambiente computacional 100% em nuvem e com foco em crescimento exponencial.

Planejar, executar e analisar experimentos de processos fermentativos upstream e downstream para o desenvolvimento de novos bioinsumos à base de biomassa e/ou metabólitos bioativos produzidos por Streptomyces, Bacillus e outros gêneros de interesse. Atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de processos fermentativos, para triagem de novos compostos, assegurando a qualidade dos resultados, a rastreabilidade dos dados, garantindo que as tecnologias desenvolvidas sejam escalonáveis, possibilitando a continuidade dos processos para produção em escala piloto e industrial de forma robusta, segura e reprodutível assegurando o ciclo de inovação e o atingimento dos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, apresentações e registros experimentais completos e organizados;
  • Apoiar a transição de processos de bancada para escala piloto, em conjunto com as áreas de Scale up e Processos;

Requisitos técnicos (hard skills)

Global Talent Acquisition Partner | Startup Hiring

Remote – Open to candidates from anywhere in the world

Latin America preferred due to timezone alignment

Working hours: US Pacific Time

Sales experience required, with strong English communication skills

About Us

At THE/STUDIO, our vision is to empower individuals, regardless of their expertise, to unleash their creativity and bring their unique ideas to life through the production of custom products. We are committed to delivering top-quality customized products that not only exceed expectations but also provide a seamless and awe‑inspiring experience via our exceptional team and AI‑integrated systems. By shouldering the manufacturing burdens, we liberate our customers to focus on their true passions, driving them towards remarkable success and fulfillment. Together, we turn dreams into tangible realities and shape a world where creativity knows no bounds.

Our headquarters are in Los Angeles, California, but we are a truly global company with team‑members across the U.S., Europe, South America, Africa, and Asia/Pacific. We have gone to a fully remote working platform so that we can attract the world’s best talent.

All roles at THE/STUDIO are 100% remote from anywhere in the world, as long as you have all your tools and a fast, stable internet connection!

We know that some applicants will not meet all the requirements, so we encourage you to apply anyway so we can determine if something else might be a good fit!

The Role

At THE/STUDIO, we help creators and brands bring their product ideas to life: from custom hats to packaging. Our Creative Specialists are trusted advisors to our customers: they don’t just close deals, they build long-term partnerships that fuel repeat business.

We’re looking for experienced sales professionals with a strong consultative sales foundation who can confidently manage inbound opportunities, uncover deeper customer needs, and nurture accounts over time. This role is ideal for someone who already knows how to sell, structure their day, and run a pipeline; and is excited to apply those skills in a fast‑paced, remote‑first startup environment.

As a Creative Specialist, you’ll own the full inbound sales cycle while developing repeat customers by helping them grow their own businesses through THE/STUDIO’s manufacturing solutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Consult with inbound leads to deeply understand customer goals, timelines, and long‑term needs.
  • Apply a consultative sales approach to guide customers through design, pricing, and production decisions.
  • Own and manage customer accounts with a focus on nurturing repeat business and long‑term value.
  • Maintain a structured, self‑driven sales workflow with clear follow‑up cadences and prioritization.
  • Manage your pipeline in HubSpot with speed, accuracy, and strong CRM hygiene.
  • Confidently handle objections and position THE/STUDIO as the trusted alternative to “cheap but risky” sourcing options.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sales Team Lead, Production, and Design teams to ensure smooth handoffs and accurate execution.
  • Oversee order tracking, delivery coordination, and post‑sale follow‑ups to strengthen customer relationships.
  • Consistently meet and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, tools, and workflows as we scale.

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First Month

  • Ramp quickly and gain a strong understanding of THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and product offering.
  • Become proficient with inbound email sequencing, fast sales cadences, and CRM workflows.
  • Begin laying the groundwork for future repeat business through thoughtful follow‑ups and account notes.

Within 3 Months

  • Master how to identify, build, and nurture repeat customers with well‑defined follow‑up cadences.
  • Run a fully self‑driven, structured day‑to‑day sales workflow.
  • Proactively advise customers on how they can grow their own businesses using THE/STUDIO.
  • Demonstrate excellent CRM hygiene and clear account ownership.
  • Be recognized by teammates as someone who raises the bar and improves team productivity.

Within 6 Months

  • Own a healthy book of repeat customers who consistently come back to work with you.
  • Continuously exceed your quota and build a strong forward‑looking pipeline.
  • Identify and implement tools, methods, or sales processes that improve performance.
  • Be on track for increased responsibility and future promotion opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years of recent, quota‑carrying sales experience (not historic).
  • Strong foundation in consultative sales (Account Executive–type experience preferred).
  • Proven ability to manage and nurture customer accounts and generate repeat business.
  • Experience selling products or solutions in high‑velocity, SMB, or service‑based environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1 minimum).
  • High energy, professional presence, and strong video communication skills.
  • Coachable, curious, resilient, and comfortable receiving direct feedback.
  • Interest in apparel, custom products, or manufacturing is a strong plus.
  • Experience collaborating with design teams; Adobe Illustrator knowledge is an advantage.
  • Highly organized with strong CRM discipline (HubSpot experience is a plus).
  • Self‑starter who thrives in a remote, fast‑moving startup environment.
  • Comfortable working US hours (PST and EST).
  • Remote‑ready setup: laptop/desktop with at least 8GB RAM, stable internet (10 Mbps+), and a quiet workspace for customer calls.

Note: This role is not suited for appointment setters, BDR‑only profiles, or candidates transitioning into sales from non‑sales backgrounds.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Fast‑growing company redefining custom manufacturing.
  • High‑quality inbound leads. NO heavy cold calling.
  • Clear metrics, dashboards, and performance transparency.
  • Real growth opportunities for top performers.
  • Competitive compensation with uncapped commissions.
  • Personalized sales training to support both your role and long‑term career growth.
  • No micromanagement: we trust experienced sellers to own their work.

On‑target earnings (OTE): $2,200+ per month (base + uncapped commissions)

Additional Attributes & Process

  • Intellectually curious – possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right
  • Self‑motivated with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence
  • Good communication skills that enhance collaboration, minimize misunderstandings, and at a frequency that is appropriate for a remote team
  • Radical candor – coachable, accepting of constructive negative feedback and willing to provide constructive negative feedback where applicable
  • Operates with a level of urgency – values immediate action where prudent, enables quick decision‑making, swift problem‑solving, and seizing opportunities in a dynamic business environment
  • Natural customer centricity – has an affinity to always start their train of thought or analysis with the customer’s perspective, bias toward talking to the customer to understand them
  • Results‑driven – focuses on achieving and exceeding measurable objectives
  • Submit an application. IMPORTANT: Please submit your resume/CV in English

  • Written Assessment and Mock Call
  • CEO Interview
  • Reference Check

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Regardless of the result, we always inform candidates via email.

Our policy is to provide equal opportunities for all applicants and individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We prioritize and maintain a fair, inclusive and equitable workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

description:
Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880

Turing is one of the world’s fastest‑growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real‑world AI systems that solve mission‑critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine‑tune and improve large language models (like GPT), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future‑prove your career in an AI‑first world!

What does day‑to‑day look like

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day?

Requirements

  • Multilingual capabilities (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self‑motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor’s degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in data interpretation, logical reasoning and basic arithmetic is highly desirable.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC‑8:00 (2‑5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Strategy Lead, YouTube Ads
description:
Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in advertising sales, marketing, consulting, or media (e.g., search, social, mobile, display, and video media).
  • 7 years of experience creating and presenting customer-facing materials (e.g., pitches, narratives, or one-sheets) for sales teams.
  • 7 years of experience in consumer and market insights, media measurement, and privacy landscape.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to engage with local stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • 10 years of experience with social media insights data analytics.
  • Experience in product Go-to-Market (GTM) or commercial strategy roles.
  • Expertise in the Brazilian media market, including a sophisticated understanding of the TV ecosystem, viewership trends, and the competitive landscape of local broadcasters and streamers.

About The Job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today\'s dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As the YouTube Ads Strategy Lead, you will serve as the primary architect for YouTube’s product and business generation strategy in Brazil. Sitting at the intersection of Product and Sales, you function as a Product Lead within a commercial structure, driving the long-term roadmap for how YouTube competes for and wins advertising budgets.

Your strategy will be rooted in a deep, holistic understanding of the platform’s ecosystem—starting from user consumption behavior to inform monetization frameworks. You will be the go-to expert on the Brazilian media landscape, leveraging deep knowledge from traditional TV to social platforms dynamics to position YouTube as the premier choice for advertisers. You will translate complex internal data into actionable business intelligence, crafting the narratives that drive video products adoption and revenue growth.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Centralize YouTube’s business generation strategy in Brazil, acting as the bridge between local sales and global teams.
  • Build a platform outlook based on user behavior, arming sales with data-driven narratives that connect consumption patterns to brand buying strategies.
  • Co-lead the annual plan, prioritizing and communicating Brazil’s business requirements to global product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Analyze data and market trends to identify opportunities, developing strategies to reach business goals.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Supply Chain Analyst - Capacity Planning
description:
About Latitude.sh

Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.

We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single‑tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.

Summary

The Supply Chain Analyst will play a key role in developing and managing Latitude.sh’s capacity planning and vendor analysis framework across global data center operations — including space, power, network, and servers. Working closely with Procurement, Operations, and Finance teams, the analyst will anticipate capacity requirements, evaluate vendor proposals, and deliver clear reporting that guides infrastructure and procurement strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Capacity Planning & Forecasting
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive capacity planning models for data center space, power, servers, and network resources such as IP transit and backbone connectivity.
  • Forecast utilization to identify where capacity constraints may occur across the global portfolio.
  • Track provisioned versus active usage and provide early visibility into expansion needs.
  • Maintain dashboards showing available capacity, forecasted growth, and expected exhaustion timelines by site and service type.
  • Vendor Evaluation & Cost Analysis
  • Analyze and compare vendor proposals and quotes for data center colocation, IP transit, backbone, and related network services.
  • Build standardized cost‑comparison models to identify the most cost‑efficient vendor options.
  • Support procurement decisions with clear, data‑driven recommendations and total cost analyses.
  • Monitor vendor pricing, terms, and performance to ensure competitiveness and long‑term value.
  • Operational Reporting & Insights
  • Develop and manage a monthly reporting package or dashboard showing month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year variances in data center and network costs, and aggregate breakdowns by region, vendor, and service category.
  • Compare committed capacity versus billed actuals to identify underutilized or overextended resources and ensure full use of contracted commitments.
  • Validate and reconcile data across Finance and Operations to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Present insights and recommendations that inform vendor selection, cost optimization, and capacity planning across teams.

Skills And Qualifications

description:
Full Stack Developer for Cloud based Applications

Join to apply for the Full Stack Developer for Cloud based Applications role at TK Elevator

Are you ready to shape the future of vertical transportation by building the digital solutions that power innovation? At TK Elevator, a globally leading elevator and escalator company, we're revolutionizing how people experience buildings through digital solutions that integrate elevator systems, embedded technology, cloud platforms, and AI-powered experiences.

Responsibilities

As full stack Application Developer, you'll bring a hands‑on, pragmatic get‑things‑done attitude to designing, developing, and maintaining digital service applications that bridge the physical and digital worlds. You'll roll up your sleeves to work closely with cross‑functional teams—UX/UI designers, product owners, and fellow developers—to deliver scalable, secure, and user‑friendly solutions that make our customers successful and transform service efficiency for 20,000+ technicians worldwide.

  • Application Development & Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain modern web and mobile applications using frameworks like Angular, .NET, and MAUI. Build cloud‑native solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with microservices, event‑driven architectures, and API‑first design principles.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work closely with UX/UI designers, product owners, architects, and other development teams to translate business requirements into elegant technical solutions. Contribute to architectural decisions and share knowledge across the global team.
  • Code Excellence & Best Practices: Write clean, maintainable, and well‑documented code that others can understand and build upon. Participate actively in code reviews, champion best practices, and continuously improve code quality and development standards.
  • DevOps & Quality Integration: Develop automated tests and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and efficient deployment. Support continuous integration and delivery practices that enable rapid, safe releases to production.
  • Performance & Reliability: Troubleshoot issues proactively, optimise application performance, and provide ongoing support for existing applications. Monitor system health and respond to incidents when needed to ensure high availability.
  • Security‑First Mindset: Integrate cybersecurity best practices into all phases of the development lifecycle. Implement secure authentication/authorization, protect sensitive data, and stay current with security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.

Qualifications

  • Development Experience & Expertise: 5+ years of hands‑on experience in application development with a proven track record building cloud‑native applications. Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and C# with deep experience in modern frameworks including Angular, .NET, and MAUI.
  • Cloud & Architecture Proficiency: Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms, particularly Azure, and solid understanding of microservices architectures, event‑driven systems, and API‑first design. Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous messaging systems (Kafka, MQTT).
  • DevOps & Modern Development Practices: Strong understanding of DevOps practices and tools including Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana and OpenTelemetry. Experience with infrastructure as code and containerisation is a plus.
  • Security & Compliance Knowledge: Understanding of secure software design principles, authentication/authorization mechanisms (OAuth2, OpenID Connect), and data protection requirements. Experience implementing security best practices in application development.
  • Agile & Team Collaboration: Proven experience working in agile, cross‑functional product teams with ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and time zones. Comfortable in a fast‑paced, iterative development environment.
  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Personal Attributes

  • Problem‑solver: Strong analytical skills with ability to break down complex requirements into elegant solutions.
  • Pragmatic & hands‑on: Strongly driven, get‑things‑done attitude—ready to roll up your sleeves and go the extra mile to make products successful.
  • Team player & independent: Collaborative team member who can also take ownership and work independently when needed.
  • Clear communicator: Good communication skills in English, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Quality‑focused: Takes pride in writing clean code and building solutions that users love.

Benefits

Health care, Dental care, Bonus, Private pension, Program for pregnant women, Social support program, Life insurance, Telemedicine, Telenutrition, Telepsychology, Restaurant, Transportation.

Company

People are at the heart of everything we do at TK Elevator: we work as a team, care about each other’s safety and share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to go further and impact the future of urban mobility.

Mid‑Senior level

A UniFECAF , fundada em 2015, nasceu com a missão de ser um polo difusor de conhecimento e se consolidar como a melhor faculdade da região. Iniciada pela união de Joel, Sandra, seus irmãos e Marcel Gama, a instituição rapidamente cresceu.

Em 2018, a UniFECAF recebeu o reconhecimento do MEC , obtendo a nota 4 no Índice Geral de Cursos (IGC). Este marco foi acompanhado pelo lançamento dos primeiros cursos de Educação a Distância (EAD), ampliando o acesso ao ensino de qualidade.

Em 2021, a UniFECAF deu um passo significativo ao lançar a pós-graduação digital e ingressar no grupo G7, composto por instituições de ensino em crescimento. Nesse mesmo ano, a instituição foi recredenciada com nota máxima pelo MEC e no final de 2022 alcançou o status de Centro Universitário , resultando em um rebranding da marca.

Atualmente, como Centro Universitário UniFECAF, nossa missão é proporcionar ensino de qualidade, promover a pesquisa e a extensão, contribuindo para a formação integral do aluno e para o desenvolvimento social e econômico da região. Com um compromisso contínuo com a excelência acadêmica, a UniFECAF se destaca como uma referência em educação superior.

Gerenciar investimentos, acompanhar indicadores de performance e garantir a eficiência das campanhas. Conduzir estratégias de SEO técnico, conteúdo e autoridade para ampliar o tráfego orgânico. description:
Sobre a Comolatti

Referência nacional no aftermarket da indústria automotiva brasileira, o Grupo Comolatti possui uma trajetória de mais de 65 anos de tradição. Com profundo conhecimento em diversos setores, desde a distribuição de autopeças, a comercialização de veículos até a alta gastronomia e o setor imobiliário, o grupo se destaca pela sua dedicação, integridade, comprometimento e espírito empreendedor. Esse compromisso, que atravessou gerações, consolidou o Grupo Comolatti como um dos mais respeitados e tradicionais grupos do setor automotivo brasileiro.

ANALISTA DE CONTROLADORIA SR

Estamos em busca de um profissional para integrar nosso time financeiro, que seja comprometido e tenha um espírito empreendedor. Valorizamos essas qualidades porque acreditamos que é assim que conseguimos pensar grande, alcançar mais e, dessa forma, ajudar, inspirar e transformar nossos clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar análises financeiras detalhadas sobre variações de Receita Bruta, Tributos, Custo da Mercadoria Vendida, Despesas Operacionais, Resultado Financeiro, Margem Bruta, EBITDA e Lucro Líquido;
  • Emitir pareceres financeiros com base nas análises de desempenho econômico das áreas;
  • Acompanhar e revisar periodicamente o orçamento empresarial (Plano Orçamentário, Revisões Mensais e Rolling Forecast);
  • Estabelecer relacionamento direto com gestores de centros de custo e centros de resultado, promovendo o entendimento das variações e orientando a gestão financeira das áreas;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards com base em ferramentas de BI e Excel avançado;
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade das informações apresentadas à alta gestão;
  • Contribuir com o aprimoramento de controles internos, políticas e procedimentos da área de controladoria;
  • Apoiar a área contábil e de auditoria com informações de performance financeira, quando necessário.

Requisitos Que Gostaríamos Que Você Tivesse

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração de Empresas ou Ciências Econômicas;
  • Excel avançado (análises, modelagens e dashboards);
  • Conhecimento dos principais conceitos de controladoria, análise de desempenho e indicadores financeiros;
  • Familiaridade com processos orçamentários, revisão e forecast;
  • Atuação em empresas comerciais e industriais;
  • Vivência em empresas de capital aberto (diferencial);
  • Experiência com o contato direto com gestores operacionais e executivos em processos de análise e controle.

Sobre a Vaga

  • Localização: Consolação/SP;
  • Modelo: Presencial;
  • Contratação: CLT por tempo indeterminado;
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 08h às 18h, com 01h12 de intervalo;
  • Benefícios: Vale-Refeição, Previdência Privada, Seguro de Vida, Assistência odontológica, Assistência médica, Vale-transporte, Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • Esta vaga é aberta a todos os candidatos, incluindo pessoas com deficiência.

Como Se Candidatar

Buscamos talentos diversos para compor nosso time. Se você se identifica com nossos valores e está pronto para fazer a diferença, inscreva-se!

title: Creative PR Manager, Global Communications
description:
Creative PR Manager, Global Communications

Responsibilities

About the Team
TikTok’s Global Communications team is charged with telling the company's story and protecting the public trust that is fundamental to TikTok’s success. The team works across all business functions and regions to clearly articulate what TikTok is, what it stands for, and how it operates. Through clear, authentic, and purposeful storytelling, Global Comms engages the many audiences that interact with the platform, including global media, policymakers, key opinion leaders, professional creators, communities, and businesses of all sizes. Joining Global Communications offers a rare opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology and culture, shaping global conversations around the world.

About the Role
TikTok’s Global Communications team is looking for a strategic, hands‑on Creative PR Manager to join our Latin America team, based in Brazil. This role sits at the intersection of culture, technology, and reputation, playing a key part in shaping TikTok’s public narrative across the region.

If you thrive in fast‑paced environments, think big while executing with precision, and love building stories that travel across culture, media, and business, this role is for you.

  • Lead proactive, culturally relevant communication strategies that connect creators, SMBs, and audiences to the TikTok brand.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Operations, Marketing, Social, and Public Policy teams, bringing bold ideas that challenge the status quo.
  • Build strong relationships with media, key opinion leaders, and creator communities to generate distinctive, earned cultural moments.
  • Drive reputation management efforts across Latin America through innovative, insight‑driven PR strategies.
  • Translate complex policy, safety, and business topics into clear, compelling narratives for external audiences.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in communications, PR, or marketing (entertainment, tech, or related industries preferred).
  • Full professional proficiency in Portuguese and English (English is required for daily collaboration with global partners).
  • Proven experience working cross‑functionally with Marketing, Social, and Creator teams to deliver integrated communication strategies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of leading creative, differentiated campaigns in competitive markets.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to thrive in fast‑paced, high‑growth environments.
  • Passion for storytelling and media relations across Latin America.

About ByteDance Brazil

ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok’s mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We’re resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an “Always Day 1” mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

Na Nextar, sabemos que uma equipe diversa é a chave para a inovação e para criar soluções que realmente transformem a vida das pessoas a frente do comércio. O respeito às diferenças é um dos nossos valores culturais.

Por isso, criamos este Banco de Talentos de Diversidade e Inclusão : um canal exclusivo e prioritário para conhecer profissionais incríveis que se autodeclaram como parte de qualquer grupo diverso (seja por raça/etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, pessoa com deficiência, 50+, ou outros).

O objetivo é simples: queremos conhecer você agora , mesmo que a vaga dos seus sonhos ainda não esteja aberta.

Como funciona o Banco de Talentos?

  1. Inscrição: Você preenche nosso formulário de inscrição (são 13 perguntas rápidas) e nos conta sobre suas habilidades, experiências e áreas de interesse.

  2. Análise: Nossa equipe de Recrutamento & Seleção irá analisar seu perfil com carinho e adicioná-lo ao nosso banco interno, organizado por áreas de talento.

  3. Prioridade: Assim que uma nova oportunidade alinhada ao seu perfil surgir, você será uma das primeiras pessoas a saber! Entraremos em contato assim que abrirmos a vaga para o público geral, usando o local que você indicou no questionário.

Um pouco sobre a Nextar:

Somos pessoas apaixonadas pelo comércio! A Nextar atua desde 2003 criando soluções que transformem o comércio em uma atividade simples, justa e economicamente viável. Acreditamos nas pessoas e no empreendedorismo e nos dedicamos todos os dias para sermos facilitadores da rotina do pequeno comércio. Por isso, trabalhamos para desenvolver e entregar produtos e serviços de qualidade para mais de 50 mil pequenos comércios no Brasil e no mundo!

O que buscamos nas pessoas para compor nossa equipe?

Comprometimento e prazer em trabalhar colaborativamente — que busque facilitar a vida das pessoas, tanto colegas, quanto clientes e empenhe-se em manter o ambiente amigável.

Atenção à comunicação escrita e oral — que seja empática, assertiva e que agregue uma escuta verdadeira.

Organização pessoal e responsabilidade — prezamos por pessoas colaboradoras que façam bom uso da autonomia.

Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade — mantemos a mente curiosa, aberta a ideias e acreditamos estar constantemente em evolução, buscando cada vez mais por melhores soluções.

Respeito às diferenças — temos a diversidade e a inclusão como valor cultural e prezamos por manter nosso time diverso, agregando o valor de paradigmas únicos para expandir nossa qualidade e alcance. Temos muito a aprender ainda e temos também muita vontade de ampliarmos a nossa consciência cada dia mais.

Honestidade intelectual — tenha proatividade em busca de conhecimento, generosidade em compartilhar o seu saber e abertura, humildade e respeito para orientar e receber orientações.

E identifique-se com gestão orgânica — a serviço das pessoas e para as pessoas.

E um pouquinho a mais sobre nós:

Presente no Brasil desde 1971, a Motorola Honda da Amazônia Ltda. é atualmente a maior fabricante de motos do país, com mais de 28 milhões de unidades produzidas em Manaus (AM). Desde 2001, a empresa produz também motores estacionários e motobombas, além de comercializar a linha de motores e máquinas no país.

A companhia procura, por meio de seus produtos e serviços, proporcionar experiências diferenciadas e seguras às pessoas. Também acredita que apoiar colaboradores e comunidades na realização de seus desejos é uma forma de construir um futuro melhor.
